encounter.title: Act I Encounter 2 — The Cross-Lock (seed 112)
encounter.notes: ACT-I-001 playtest content (docs/ACT-I-FIRST-3-SHORTLIST.md §3). easy 6x7 seed 112 (9 arrows: N2 E3 S1 W3). Cross-Lock pattern: N#3 unlocks E#2, E#0 unlocks N#4. Grunt E (hp 2, ATTACK IN 3, dmg 2); Grunt N (hp 2, ATTACK IN 4, dmg 2). Shared RunState Rotate pool. Proven clean path without Rotate: 0 damage in 4 taps (tap #0 -> tap #3 -> tap #2 -> tap #4).
